model: Primo GEN24 / Symo GEN24 (Plus) SunSpec int+SF
applies_to: Fronius Primo/Symo GEN24 (Plus) rest-of-world variants with a battery configured, SunSpec Model Type int+SF; without a battery the MPPT model has 2 inputs and model 124 is absent.
summary: GEN24 hybrid inverters host Modbus TCP and RTU themselves and present a SunSpec map: common block, inverter model 101/103, nameplate, settings, status, immediate controls, multiple-MPPT (PV inputs 1-2 plus battery charge/discharge as inputs 3-4) and basic storage control. This map covers the 16-bit measurements, ratings, battery state of charge and every control register, each scaled through its SunSpec scale factor.

addressing.note: Fronius numbers SunSpec registers from 40001 and says to send the register number minus one: register 40001 is read at address 40000 (0x9C40). The manual's RTU example reads register 40005 (Mn) with address bytes 9C 44 (40004).

firmware: Register map archive 1.2.7-2 (bundled with GEN24 firmware 1.36.x); manual 42,0410,2649 rev. 034-28092026.

source.title: Fronius GEN24 Modbus TCP & RTU (operating instructions) + Gen24_Primo_Symo_Inverter_Register_Map_Int&SF_storage_ROW.xlsx
source.pages: PDF English part: register addresses and examples pp. 68-70, unavailable values p. 71, scale factors p. 74-75, Modbus settings pp. 76-79, models pp. 80-92. Register table = XLSX sheet 'Complete Map' in https://www.fronius.com/en/~/downloads/Solar%20Energy/Operating%20Instructions/gen24-modbus-api-external-docs.zip

notes: Register table from Fronius' official GEN24 XLSX (gen24-modbus-api-external-docs.zip, linked from the Fronius Modbus TCP open-interfaces page); behaviour and settings from the PDF.

Addresses assume SunSpec Model Type = int+SF and a battery configured. With float the inverter model is 111/113 and later models move by +10. Without a battery the MPPT model has only inputs 1-2 and the end block follows at 40304. Fronius advises walking the model chain from 40001 rather than hard-coding addresses.

Word order: neither the PDF nor the XLSX states the order of 32/64-bit values, so they are left out: SID 40001-40002, WH 40094-40095, Evt1/Evt2/EvtVnd1-2 40110-40117, ActWh 40187-40190, StActCtl 40217-40218, Tms 40223-40224, and DCWH/Tms of every MPPT input. The SID is documented as 0x53756E53 'SunS', which suggests high word first, but this is not stated.
DCA/DCV in the inverter model are left out: GEN24 has several DC inputs, their scale factors are marked not supported, and per-input values are in model 160.

Registers marked 'not supported' in the XLSX are left out (Opt, other temperatures, VMax/VMin, ramp settings, model 160 Tmp/DCSt/DCEvt, StorAval, InBatV and similar). VAChaMax (40350) is listed as writable but its scale factor VAChaMax_SF is marked not supported, so it is left out too.
Many scale factors are 'auto-scaled' (A, W, VA, VAr, WH, DCW, Ris, model 160): they change at runtime, so read a value and its SF in the same request.
Unsupported values read as: int16 0x8000, uint16/enum16/bitfield16 0xFFFF, sunssf 0x8000. Phase B/C and line-line points depend on the grid connection.
Settings model 121 registers are all read-only in the GEN24 map (the Datamanager map marks some writable).
StVnd is documented as identical to St; the PDF lists SunSpec states 1-8.
The Smart Meter is published at its own unit ID (default 200, then 201-204) with a separate common block and meter model starting at 40001; not part of this map.

integration.summary: In the inverter web UI (Communication > Modbus) enable the TCP server, select int+SF and tick Allow Control if you need writes; then poll unit ID 1. Read registers 40070-40109 (wire addresses 40069-40108) for live data, register 40352 (address 40351) for battery SoC, and use models 123/124 for power limits and battery windows.

minimum_registers.why: Inverter model ID (101/103) - confirms int+SF layout

integration.enable: Inverter web interface > Communication > Modbus: choose TCP Server and/or RTU Server, set SunSpec Model Type (int+SF for this map), and activate 'Allow Control' for on/off, power reduction, power factor, reactive power and battery commands. 'Restrict Control' limits control to fixed IP addresses. Writes to models 123/124 raise an exception when control is not allowed.
integration.watchdog: Model 123 controls have *_RvrtTms fallback timers (0-28800 s) that restart with every Modbus message; on expiry the control ends and the next-priority mode takes over. 0 (default) keeps the setting until disabled. Model 124 has InOutWRte_RvrtTms (0-28800 s) for the battery window.
quirks: Off-by-one: SunSpec registers are numbered from 40001; request number minus one (40001 -> 40000).
Switching float/int+SF changes the address of every model after the inverter model.
Battery power appears as MPPT inputs 3 (charge) and 4 (discharge); only one is non-zero at a time.
Storage window sign convention: negative power = charging, positive = discharging; OutWRte/InWRte may be negative to force charging or discharging.
Writes to read-only or unsupported registers are silently ignored; out-of-range values return exception 3.
setup: TCP: inverter unit ID is always 1 (identify devices by IP address); port 502 or 1502 selectable in the web UI.
RTU: set Inverter address (1-247, factory 1), interface M0 or M1, baud and parity in the web UI; each inverter on the bus needs a unique address.
RTU wiring: 120-ohm termination enabled at both line ends, shielded twisted pair, single-point grounding, strict daisy chain.
Smart Meter unit ID is set via 'Meter address offset' (factory 200).
gotchas: Query sequentially (at most 2 requests in parallel) with a response timeout of at least 1 s; read blocks rather than single registers.
Grid charging via ChaGriSet only works if 'battery charging from DNO grid' is also enabled in the system settings (the two are AND-linked).
Changing InWRte/OutWRte/StorCtl_Mod shows up in Solar.web as Forced Recharge or Energy saving mode.
After changing a value of an active mode (e.g. a new WMaxLimPct), re-write the matching _Ena register with 1.
